3	## Problem
4	
5	After the Reference card arrived, there was no way from a project's page to
6	create its architecture.

8	## Cause
9	
10	- The Reference card (`server/views/projects/_reference.eta`) showed a row

12	  architecture never linked to `/f/<id>/architecture`, the page that offers

14	  whole card was hidden.
15	- New design (`server/views/projects/_new-design.eta`) offered only the
16	  design system and app shell as kinds; the architecture kind came only from
17	  `?kind=architecture`, which only the Architecture page links to.
18

22	  with components; its design when made but empty; New design with
23	  `?kind=system` when not made. Architecture: always `/architecture`, saying

I've fixed the duplicate. You weren't looking at old code, though: main has both radios too.

**Why it happened:** both fixes are already in main. PR #42 added "The project's architecture" to New design's Kind, and the earlier "I added support for a project's architecture view…" fix added it too, with different wording. Each branch added a different line in the same place, so git merged them without a conflict and kept both. The tests only checked that `value="architecture"` appeared somewhere, so two still passed.

**What I changed:**
- **`server/views/projects/_new-design.eta`:** removed the second radio. The one left reads "drafted from the code; every agent reads it before it changes anything", which matches the modal's own intro text.
- **`test/system.test.js`:** the test now checks that the architecture is offered exactly once.
- **`prelude/project-landing-page/NOTES.md`:** removed an empty `## Open questions` heading the same merge left behind, and added a line about this fix.
- **`prelude/fixes/the-option-to-create-an-architecture-is-duplicated-in-the/NOTES.md`:** written with the problem, the cause, the change and what to check.

**Review of the two commits:** I can't run git here, so I didn't read their diffs line by line. Instead I read everything both fixes say they touched, as it is now on this branch: the Reference card, rules R-x4b and R-wm3, the `/system` and `/architecture` routes and the architecture design's page in `server/main.js`, and their tests. I found no other duplicates or merge leftovers. One small thing I left alone: the comment above New design's route in `server/main.js` still says "?kind= picks the design system or the shell" and doesn't mention the architecture.

**To check:**
- Run `node --test test/system.test.js test/system-page.test.js`, then `npm test`.
- Project Landing Page's `new-project` New design modal will differ from its approved screen by one less choice. That change is on purpose.
